# boost-math-wasm 0.5.0

Boost.Math built for WebAssembly by Emscripten (double precision): special functions,
distributions and statistics. An unofficial build from the fork https://github.com/NAThompson/math,
release `boost-math-v0.5.0` (https://github.com/NAThompson/math/releases), file
`boost-math-wasm-0.5.0.tgz`, SHA-256
`25a7409a52ae93df4bd14a427d323ed7fb1289778a37a12dd2a50e0942704009`.

`boost_math.mjs`, `boost_math.wasm`, `boost_math.d.ts` and `LICENSE` are that package's files,
unmodified (its `package.json` and `README.md` are left out). Boost Software License 1.0; the
Emscripten runtime and musl parts are under the licences in `LICENSE`. Loaded by `deno/lib/boost.ts`.
